unproject_depth_to_3d: unproject 2D image points with depth values to 3D points in camera or world space
project_3d_to_image: project 3D world points to 2D image coordinates using camera intrinsics and world-to-cam transform
transform_points_batch: apply batch matrix multiplication between transformation matrices and 3D points
compute_inverse_intrinsics: compute the inverse of camera intrinsics matrices analytically for fast depth unprojection
check_points_in_image: check if image points are within the image boundaries and above a minimum depth threshold
